en: Don't lie in my face! You slept with another woman last night!
zh: 你呃得就呃啦！你琴晚根本就係去咗去滾嚟！
target: Don't lie! You were clearly unfaithful last night!

en: Why are you mistreating yourself by signing a five-year contract with that label company? All those who signed with that company usually become unpopular singers.
zh: 做咩要咁睇唔開要簽呢間唱片公司五年約？通常簽親呢間唱片公司都會半紅不黑㗎喎。
target: Why are you sabotaging your career by signing a five-year contract with that label company? All those who signed with that company usually became unpopular singers.

target: Post on Instagram.

en: Wow, that's why someone is getting slutty, because she is adoring the guy.
zh: 嘩，唔怪得發晒姣咁啦，原來有人十月芥菜。
target: Wow, that's why she's being so flirty, someone has caught her eye.

en: An abductor appears at Kowloon City for a period of time.
zh: 九龍城有一排出現拐子佬。
target: There had been reports of abduction incidents in Kowloon City for a while.

en: Pregnant and so clumsy, you shouldn't go here and there all the time - ask your maid to do it for you.
zh: 你粗身大勢就唔好走嚟走去喇，有咩咪叫工人做囖。
target: Given that you're pregnant and unsteady on your feet, it's best not to move around much - ask your maid for help.

en: I don't care what you say.
zh: 我#話之你 點講。
target: I couldn't care less about what you say.

en: You are going out with a girl on a date at a western-style restaurant! You shouldn't wear clothes that look so untidy. Give her a good impression!
zh: 約女仔去西餐廳食飯就咪着到咁褸丘啦，畀返個好印象人哋吖嘛。
target: You're going out with a girl on a date at a western-style restaurant! Don't dress too sloppily, make a good impression!

en: Let's go disco to dance tonight.
zh: 今晚一齊落D䟴返下啦。
target: Let's go dancing at a club tonight.

en: It's all because you not going, now we don't have enough people.
zh: 鬼叫你唔去咩，而家唔夠人嘞。
target: It's your fault for not going; now we're short-handed.

en: After borning a son, her belly is still very glossy.
zh: 佢生完仔之後個肚皮仲係好光滑。
target: Her belly remained smooth after giving birth to a son.

en: The factory leakages some gas.
zh: 間工廠有氣體泄漏。
target: The factory is had a gas leakage incident.

en: The factory leakages some gas.
zh: 間工廠有氣體泄漏。
target: The factory is leaking gas.

en: I don't want to see in the front rows.
zh: 我唔想坐前排啊。
target: I don't want to sit in the front row.

en: City people like me ate so much rice, but never seen the grain of uncooked rice.
zh: 我呢啲城市人飯就食得多，稻米真係未見過。
target: As a city dweller, I've eaten a lot of rice, but rarely see uncooked rice grains.

en: He's twenty but his soft spot hasn't closed yet. (How could he) believe in everything others say.
zh: 成二十歲人腦囟都未生埋，人哋講佢就信。
target: He's twenty but still childish; he believes everything others say.

en: He's twenty but his soft spot hasn't closed yet. (How could he) believe in everything others say.

target: He's twenty but still gullible; he believes everything others say.

en: Fortunately your uncle, me, is good at recognizing new stars. I know you are a bastard from the start.
zh: 好彩阿叔我慧眼識新星，一睇就知你係冚家拎。
target: Fortunately, I recognized your potential early on.

en: The owner of that restaurant who used to cheat his employees now end up begging on the street as if punished by divine retribution.
zh: 以前對面間酒樓嗰個無良僱主而家折墮到要乞食啊。
target: The restaurant owner who once cheated his employees is now begging on the streets, seemingly punished by fate.

en: All my royal subjects admire me.
zh: 朕嘅子民都好仰慕朕。
target: All my subjects greatly admire me.

en: long period of hunger strike
zh: 馬拉松式#絕食 抗議
target: A prolonged hunger strike as a form of protest.

en: With summer comes the rain, if the sewers are clogged up, the streets will then be fucked up.
zh: 夏天為大地帶嚟雨水，渠道淤塞嘅話就好容易會水浸。
target: With summer comes the rain, and if the sewers become clogged, there may be flooding on the streets.

en: Work-from-home arrangement also applies in our company. Thus generally speaking, I can just hide myself at home as a dispirited old folk through and through.
zh: 我公司都有work from home，所以一般嚟講真係可以韞咗喺屋企徹頭徹尾做一個廢老。
target: Our company allows work from home, so generally speaking, I can just stay at home doing nothing all day like a couch potato.

en: Your bangs are messy. You should comb it.
zh: 你擗陰亂咗呀，你梳梳佢。
target: Your bangs look unkempt. Comb them out.

en: (You) take that book to me. Can you hear me?
zh: 你𢬿嗰部書擰俾我啊，聽見冇？
target: Give me that book, can you hear me?

en: Do you feel there are some "beings" in here?
zh: 你覺唔覺得呢度有啲污糟嘢啊？
target: Do you feel there are some supernatural beings here?

en: To stop this scumbag to keep on the evil act, I have the only choice to die together with him!
zh: 為咗唔俾呢個惡霸再作惡落去，我唯有拉埋佢一齊同歸於盡！
target: To stop this scumbag from continuing his evil acts, I have no choice but to take him down with me!

en: Kid, stop butting in, go back and eat.
zh: 細路你唔好再喺度嘴招招喇，快啲食嘢啦。
target: Kid, stop interrupting and eat.

en: If you will be a good boy and get a proper job, then thank Buddha that will give me some relief!
zh: 你肯乖乖哋揾工，就真係阿彌揭諦咯！
target: If you behave responsibly and get a job, I'll be very relieved, thank goodness!

en: I beg you, don't yell again! You don't have any serious matter to bother.
zh: 我保你大喇！你唔好又喺度無病呻吟啦。
target: Please stop yelling, there's no real problem bothering you.

en: I have rewritten this essay for many times.
zh: 篇文我改寫過好多次喇。
target: I've revised this essay multiple times.

en: This player just commit to the ball again!
zh: 呢個球員又標波喇！
target: This player just missed the shot again!

en: I fell off this morning and broke my phone.
zh: 今朝仆街，跌爛咗部電話。
target: I fell this morning and broke my phone.

en: This machine is totally broke, there's no way to repair it, you better buy a new one.
zh: 部機爛成咁，冇得救㗎喇，買過部算啦。
target: This machine is broken beyond repair; it's best to buy a new one.

en: She suffers a distance disadvantage by turning at the outer outside.
zh: 佢外檔入彎蝕咗位。
target: She loses ground by turning at the outer side.

en: How long have you waited?
zh: 你喺度等咗幾耐呀？
target: How long have you been waiting?
